description: This file defines the DownloadController class which manages download operations and state synchronization between the UI and the download engine in a Flutter application. It implements download list polling, enqueuing, canceling, and state restoration.

classes.name: DownloadController
classes.description: Manages download actions, state, and synchronization with the download engine and UI.

methods.name: _startPollingIfNeeded
methods.description: Begins periodic polling of download status if needed.

methods.name: _sameRecords
methods.description: Compares two lists of DownloadRecord to determine if they are equivalent.

methods.name: restoreFromDisk
methods.description: Restores download state from the engine.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes in-memory download state from the engine.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Adds a new download to the queue.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels a download by content ID.

methods.name: findByContentId
methods.description: Finds a download record by content ID.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources and stops polling.
